AND: filter grammar: the keyword joining two comparisons that both have to hold
NOT: filter grammar: the keyword turning a comparison around
OR: filter grammar: the keyword joining two comparisons where either may hold
and: filter grammar: what this reader calls an AND once it has read one
close: filter grammar: the parenthesis a group ends with
exhaustive: suss: a contract that declares every field an item has
junction: filter grammar: comparisons joined by AND or OR
keyFields: suss: a storage contract identified by the fields a caller supplies
library: suss: marker for a value a library states
local: terraform: how a reference spells a value a locals block states
negation: filter grammar: a comparison NOT turned around
open: filter grammar: the parenthesis a group starts with
operator: filter grammar: the comparison between a key and a value
or: filter grammar: what this reader calls an OR once it has read one
read: suss: what an unset gate attribute means when the entry says to read it anyway
store: suss: a resource that says a store exists without stating its containers
term: filter grammar: one comparison, the leaf of what a filter reads as
word: filter grammar: a bare run of text, a key or an unquoted value
